answer: A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 217 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. The lantern graph is validated at intake and the harbor frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and meadow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A 329 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
